# Spiel Ventures
> Spiel Ventures is Tommy Bomar, a solo JavaScript and Kotlin developer in Texas. He sells fixed-price, async (written, no calls) website audits, small fixes, digital checklists and photo restoration. Prices are posted publicly; there are no reviews or client logos yet and none are claimed.

Contact: tommytbomar@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/tommytbomar-dot
